description: This file defines interfaces and factory for the Rialto control IPC mechanism, including the IControlIpc interface and its factory, used for inter-process communication with the Rialto server.

classes.name: IControlIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create and retrieve singleton instance of IControlIpc.

classes.name: IControlIpc
classes.description: Interface defining the Rialto control IPC APIs for communication with the Rialto server.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControlIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: getControlIpc
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton IControlIpc instance, given an IControlClient pointer.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Retrieves shared memory file descriptor and size for IPC.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a new client with the IPC mechanism.
